schema_objects.Name: assets
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE assets (
 asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(asset_id)=38 AND substr(asset_id,1,6)='asset_' AND substr(asset_id,7) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(asset_id,7)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(label AS BLOB))<=4096 AND instr(label,char(0))=0),
 head TEXT,
 created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 updated_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 CHECK(created_sequence>0 AND updated_sequence>=created_sequence),
 FOREIGN KEY(asset_id,head) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(library_id)=36 AND substr(library_id,1,4)='lib_' AND substr(library_id,5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(library_id,5)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 ready INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ready IN (0,1))
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_admin_events
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog_admin_events (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(operation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND operation_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 request BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(request)='blob' AND length(request) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576),
 payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64 AND payload_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recorded_unix_nano INTEGER NOT NULL,
 receipt BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt)='blob' AND length(receipt) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048)
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_admin_events_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_admin_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_admin_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_admin_events_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_admin_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_admin_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_authority
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog_authority (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 incarnation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(incarnation)=37 AND substr(incarnation,1,5)='auth_' AND substr(incarnation,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(incarnation,6)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 owner_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_subjects(subject_id)
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_authority_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authority_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_authority WHEN NEW.singleton<>OLD.singleton OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.owner_subject_id<>OLD.owner_subject_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_authority_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_authority_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_authority BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority lifetime identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_credentials
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE catalog_credentials (
 selector TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(selector)=37 AND substr(selector,1,5)='cred_' AND substr(selector,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(selector,6)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 incarnation TEXT NOT NULL,
 subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_subjects(subject_id),
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('library','asset')),
 asset_id TEXT REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 actions BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(actions)='blob' AND length(actions) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
 verifier BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(verifier)='blob' AND length(verifier)=32),
 issued_unix INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_unix INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_unix>issued_unix),
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
 revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revoked IN (0,1)),
 CHECK((scope_kind='library' AND asset_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind='asset' AND asset_id IS NOT NULL))
)

schema_objects.Name: catalog_credentials_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_credentials_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_credentials WHEN NEW.selector<>OLD.selector OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.incarnation<>OLD.incarnation OR NEW.subject_id<>OLD.subject_id OR NEW.scope_kind<>OLD.scope_kind OR NEW.asset_id IS NOT OLD.asset_id OR NEW.actions<>OLD.actions OR NEW.verifier<>OLD.verifier OR NEW.issued_unix<>OLD.issued_unix OR NEW.expires_unix<>OLD.expires_unix OR OLD.revoked<>0 OR NEW.revoked<>1 OR NEW.generation<>OLD.generation+1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_credentials_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_credentials_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_credentials BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority lifetime identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: catalog_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog WHEN OLD.ready<>0 OR NEW.ready<>1 OR NEW.singleton<>OLD.singleton OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: credential_issuance_receipts
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE credential_issuance_receipts (
 operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_admin_events(operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 selector TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES catalog_credentials(selector)
)

schema_objects.Name: credential_issuance_receipts_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER credential_issuance_receipts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credential_issuance_receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: credential_issuance_receipts_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER credential_issuance_receipts_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credential_issuance_receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: events
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE events (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(operation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND operation_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 request BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(request)='blob' AND length(request) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576),
 payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64 AND payload_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recorded_unix_nano INTEGER NOT NULL,
 receipt BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt)='blob' AND length(receipt) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024)
)

schema_objects.Name: events_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: events_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: locations
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE locations (
 location_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(location_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND location_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 revision TEXT,
 source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(source AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND instr(source,char(0))=0),
 locator TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(locator AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND instr(locator,char(0))=0),
 created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 updated_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 removed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(removed IN (0,1)),
 CHECK(created_sequence>0 AND updated_sequence>=created_sequence),
 FOREIGN KEY(asset_id,revision) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id)
)

schema_objects.Name: locations_asset_active
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX locations_asset_active ON locations(asset_id,removed,location_id)

schema_objects.Name: locations_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER locations_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON locations WHEN NEW.location_id<>OLD.location_id OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.asset_id<>OLD.asset_id OR NEW.created_sequence<>OLD.created_sequence OR NEW.updated_sequence<OLD.updated_sequence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable location identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: locations_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER locations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON locations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog tombstone required'); END

schema_objects.Name: policy_events
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE policy_events (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(operation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND operation_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 request BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(request)='blob' AND length(request) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576),
 payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64 AND payload_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recorded_unix_nano INTEGER NOT NULL,
 receipt BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt)='blob' AND length(receipt) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024)
)

schema_objects.Name: policy_events_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER policy_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON policy_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: policy_events_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER policy_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON policy_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority row'); END

schema_objects.Name: policy_grants
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE policy_grants (
 grant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(grant_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND grant_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_subjects(subject_id),
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('library','asset')),
 asset_id TEXT REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 actions BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(actions)='blob' AND length(actions) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
 created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 updated_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 removed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(removed IN (0,1)),
 CHECK((scope_kind='library' AND asset_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind='asset' AND asset_id IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK(created_sequence>0 AND updated_sequence>=created_sequence)
)

schema_objects.Name: policy_grants_access
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX policy_grants_access ON policy_grants(subject_id,removed,scope_kind,asset_id)

schema_objects.Name: policy_grants_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER policy_grants_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON policy_grants WHEN NEW.grant_id<>OLD.grant_id OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.subject_id<>OLD.subject_id OR NEW.created_sequence<>OLD.created_sequence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: policy_grants_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER policy_grants_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON policy_grants BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority lifetime identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: policy_subjects
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE policy_subjects (
 subject_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(subject_id)=36 AND substr(subject_id,1,4)='sub_' AND substr(subject_id,5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(subject_id,5)<>'00000000000000000000000000000000'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('person','service')),
 label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(label AS BLOB))<=256 AND instr(label,char(0))=0),
 enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
 authorization_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(authorization_generation>0),
 created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 updated_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 CHECK(created_sequence>0 AND updated_sequence>=created_sequence)
)

schema_objects.Name: policy_subjects_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER policy_subjects_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON policy_subjects WHEN NEW.subject_id<>OLD.subject_id OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.kind<>OLD.kind OR NEW.created_sequence<>OLD.created_sequence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable authority identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: policy_subjects_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER policy_subjects_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON policy_subjects BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority lifetime identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: preference_control
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE preference_control (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 clock_floor_unix INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(clock_floor_unix>=0),
 subject_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(subject_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1024),
 entry_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(entry_count BETWEEN 0 AND 65536),
 receipt_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(receipt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 32768)
)

schema_objects.Name: preference_control_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_control_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON preference_control WHEN NEW.singleton<>OLD.singleton OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.clock_floor_unix<OLD.clock_floor_unix BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'preference control identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: preference_control_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_control_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON preference_control BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'preference control lifetime'); END

schema_objects.Name: preference_receipts
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE preference_receipts (
 subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES preference_subjects(subject_id),
 operation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(operation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND operation_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 request BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(request)='blob' AND length(request) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024),
 payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64 AND payload_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 receipt BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt)='blob' AND length(receipt) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
 expires_unix INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_unix>0),
 PRIMARY KEY(subject_id,operation_id)
)

schema_objects.Name: preference_receipts_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_receipts_delete AFTER DELETE ON preference_receipts BEGIN UPDATE preference_subjects SET receipt_count=receipt_count-1 WHERE subject_id=OLD.subject_id; UPDATE preference_control SET receipt_count=receipt_count-1 WHERE singleton=1; END

schema_objects.Name: preference_receipts_delete_guard
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_receipts_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON preference_receipts WHEN OLD.expires_unix>(SELECT clock_floor_unix FROM preference_control WHERE singleton=1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'unexpired preference receipt'); END

schema_objects.Name: preference_receipts_expiry
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX preference_receipts_expiry ON preference_receipts(expires_unix,subject_id,operation_id)

schema_objects.Name: preference_receipts_insert
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_receipts_insert AFTER INSERT ON preference_receipts BEGIN UPDATE preference_subjects SET receipt_count=receipt_count+1 WHERE subject_id=NEW.subject_id; UPDATE preference_control SET receipt_count=receipt_count+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

schema_objects.Name: preference_receipts_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_receipts_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON preference_receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable preference receipt'); END

schema_objects.Name: preference_receipts_subject_expiry
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX preference_receipts_subject_expiry ON preference_receipts(subject_id,expires_unix,operation_id)

schema_objects.Name: preference_subjects
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE preference_subjects (
 subject_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_subjects(subject_id),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
 entry_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(entry_count BETWEEN 0 AND 256),
 receipt_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(receipt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 128)
)

schema_objects.Name: preference_subjects_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_subjects_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON preference_subjects WHEN NEW.subject_id<>OLD.subject_id OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.generation<OLD.generation OR (NEW.generation<>OLD.generation AND NEW.generation<>OLD.generation+1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'preference generation identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: preference_subjects_insert
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_subjects_insert AFTER INSERT ON preference_subjects BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_subjects WHERE subject_id=NEW.subject_id AND library_id=NEW.library_id AND kind='person') THEN RAISE(ABORT,'preference person membership') END; UPDATE preference_control SET subject_count=subject_count+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

schema_objects.Name: preference_subjects_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preference_subjects_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON preference_subjects BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'preference generation lifetime'); END

schema_objects.Name: preferences
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE preferences (
 subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES preference_subjects(subject_id),
 asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 selection_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(selection_token)=69 AND substr(selection_token,1,5)='sel1_' AND substr(selection_token,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 person_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(person_order>0),
 selected_unix INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(selected_unix>=0 AND selected_unix<=9223372036852183807),
 expires_unix INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_unix=selected_unix+2592000),
 PRIMARY KEY(subject_id,asset_id),
 UNIQUE(subject_id,person_order)
)

schema_objects.Name: preferences_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preferences_delete AFTER DELETE ON preferences BEGIN UPDATE preference_subjects SET entry_count=entry_count-1 WHERE subject_id=OLD.subject_id; UPDATE preference_control SET entry_count=entry_count-1 WHERE singleton=1; END

schema_objects.Name: preferences_expiry
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX preferences_expiry ON preferences(expires_unix,subject_id,asset_id)

schema_objects.Name: preferences_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preferences_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON preferences WHEN NEW.subject_id<>OLD.subject_id OR NEW.asset_id<>OLD.asset_id OR NEW.selection_token=OLD.selection_token OR NEW.person_order<=OLD.person_order BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'preference replacement identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: preferences_insert
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preferences_insert AFTER INSERT ON preferences BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preference_subjects p JOIN assets a ON a.library_id=p.library_id WHERE p.subject_id=NEW.subject_id AND a.asset_id=NEW.asset_id AND p.generation=NEW.person_order) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'preference membership') END; UPDATE preference_subjects SET entry_count=entry_count+1 WHERE subject_id=NEW.subject_id; UPDATE preference_control SET entry_count=entry_count+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

schema_objects.Name: preferences_order
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER preferences_order AFTER UPDATE ON preferences WHEN NEW.person_order<>(SELECT generation FROM preference_subjects WHERE subject_id=NEW.subject_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'preference order'); END

schema_objects.Name: preferences_recent
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX preferences_recent ON preferences(subject_id,person_order DESC,asset_id)

schema_objects.Name: relationships
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE relationships (
 relationship_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(relationship_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND relationship_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 source_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 source_revision TEXT,
 target_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 target_revision TEXT,
 predicate TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(predicate AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND instr(predicate,char(0))=0),
 provenance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provenance IN ('observed','claimed','inferred')),
 source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(source AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND instr(source,char(0))=0),
 created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 updated_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 removed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(removed IN (0,1)),
 CHECK(created_sequence>0 AND updated_sequence>=created_sequence),
 FOREIGN KEY(source_asset_id,source_revision) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(target_asset_id,target_revision) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id)
)

schema_objects.Name: relationships_identity
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER relationships_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON relationships WHEN NEW.relationship_id<>OLD.relationship_id OR NEW.library_id<>OLD.library_id OR NEW.created_sequence<>OLD.created_sequence OR NEW.updated_sequence<OLD.updated_sequence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable relationship identity'); END

schema_objects.Name: relationships_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER relationships_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON relationships BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog tombstone required'); END

schema_objects.Name: relationships_source_active
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX relationships_source_active ON relationships(source_asset_id,removed,relationship_id)

schema_objects.Name: relationships_target_active
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE INDEX relationships_target_active ON relationships(target_asset_id,removed,relationship_id)

schema_objects.Name: revision_parents
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE revision_parents (
 revision_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(revision_id,parent_id),
 CHECK(revision_id<>parent_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(asset_id,revision_id) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(asset_id,parent_id) REFERENCES revisions(asset_id,revision_id)
)

schema_objects.Name: revision_parents_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER revision_parents_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON revision_parents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: revision_parents_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER revision_parents_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON revision_parents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: revisions
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE revisions (
 revision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(revision_id)=69 AND substr(revision_id,1,5)='rev1_' AND substr(revision_id,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 library_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog(library_id),
 asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id),
 canonical BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(canonical)='blob' AND length(canonical) BETWEEN 95 AND 2143),
 manifest_json BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(manifest_json)='blob' AND length(manifest_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
 created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_sequence>0) REFERENCES events(sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 UNIQUE(asset_id,revision_id)
)

schema_objects.Name: revisions_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER revisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: revisions_no_update
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER revisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END

schema_objects.Name: schema_migrations
schema_objects.SQL:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
 version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(version>=1),
 fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(fingerprint)=64 AND fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
)

schema_objects.Name: schema_migrations_no_delete
schema_objects.SQL: CREATE TRIGGER schema_migrations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON schema_migrations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable catalog row'); END
